significance: One of the 275 Paadal Petra Sthalams, standing on the south bank of the Kaveri at Kulithalai in Karur district, with hymns sung in its praise by Tirunavukkarasar (Appar).
story: Shiva is said to have appeared to the sage Kanva in the kadamba forest here, whence the place was called Kadambanthurai.
